info.title: JuriSign API
info.description: Electronic signature API (eIDAS SES level) with OTP verification (email or SMS). Upload documents, create signature requests with multiple signers, and track the signing process via webhooks. Rate limits, per minute and per authenticated user: 60 regular calls, 20 document uploads, 30 send/cancel/relaunch actions, 30 webhook management calls. Authentication is limited to 10 attempts per minute for the targeted account, plus 60 per minute for the calling IP. Exceeding a limit returns 429 with a Retry-After header — wait for it rather than retrying immediately.

servers.description: Production (also serves sandbox requests — see POST /auth/sandbox-token)

get.description: Returns the current API status and version information.

post.description: Authenticate with email/password to obtain a Bearer token, scoped to your organization. By default the token is granted all 5 available scopes (documents:read, documents:write, sign-requests:read, sign-requests:write, webhooks:manage). Pass `scopes` to request a restricted subset instead — every endpoint checks the token's abilities and returns 403 if the required scope is missing. Rate limited to 10 attempts per minute for the targeted account, and 60 per minute for the calling IP.

device_name.description: Optional device identifier. Tokens with the same device name will be revoked and replaced.

scopes.description: Optional. Restricts the token to the given scopes. `sign-requests:read` / `sign-requests:write` also cover the templates and bulk-* endpoints. Omit to receive all 5 scopes (default, unchanged behavior for existing integrations).

403.description: Account not in an organization or organization suspended

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 attempts/minute for the targeted account, 60/minute for the calling IP) — see the Retry-After header

delete.description: Revoke the Bearer token used in this request.

post.description: Authenticate with the same email/password as POST /auth/token, but obtain a sandbox token instead (prefixed sandbox_...). Requests made with this token never send real SMS or emails (SMS are logged, emails go through the log mailer) and never deduct signature credits. Documents and signature requests created in sandbox mode are isolated from your organization's real data: they never appear in a normal (non-sandbox) request, and vice versa. A sandbox token can only be used with the sandbox_ prefix, and a normal token can never be used with it — mixing the two returns 401. Rate limited to 10 attempts per minute for the targeted account, and 60 per minute for the calling IP.

device_name.description: Optional device identifier. Tokens with the same device name will be revoked and replaced.

403.description: Account not in an organization or organization suspended

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 attempts/minute for the targeted account, 60/minute for the calling IP) — see the Retry-After header

get.description: Retrieve your organization's real-time signature credit consumption. Scoped strictly to the organization of the authenticated token.

credits_remaining.description: Never negative, even if usage exceeds the plan.

get.description: Retrieve reusable sign request templates for your organization.
Retrieve full details of a template, including signers and signature zones.

delete.description: Delete a template and its own copy of the PDF, if any.

post.description: Create a signature request from a template, reusing its signers, signature zones, and (if present) its own copy of the document. Subject, message, expiry and redirect_url can be overridden. If the template has no document of its own, `document_id` is required.

document_id.description: Required only if the template has no document of its own

get.description: Retrieve reusable merge-field HTML templates used by bulk campaigns.

post.description:
Create a merge-field HTML template (e.g. `

Bonjour {{prenom}} {{nom}}

`). Merge fields are auto-extracted from the content.

delete.description: Fails with 422 if the template is still referenced by a campaign.

post.description: Create a bulk campaign with recipients provided directly as JSON (no Excel upload needed for API clients). Each recipient generates one individualized sign request, merged from the bulk template. Invalid rows (missing fields, invalid email, duplicate email) are skipped and reported in `skipped_recipients`, not fatal.

items.description: Extra keys are accepted and become available as {{merge fields}} in the bulk template.

delete.description: Fails with 422 if the campaign is currently processing.

post.description: Dispatches an asynchronous job that generates each recipient's document, creates their sign request, and sends it. Fails with 422 if the organization does not have enough remaining credits.
Resets recipients in error back to pending so the campaign can be launched again.

get.description: Per-recipient status, send/sign timestamps, and error messages.
Retrieve the shareable public forms (PowerForms) of your organization.

post.description: Publish a shareable link backed by one of your sign request templates. Anyone opening the link fills in their details and becomes the signer of their own signature request, generated on the fly. The template MUST have exactly one signer and its own copy of the PDF.

sign_request_template_id.description: Template with exactly 1 signer and its own document

daily_submission_limit.description: Anti-abuse cap; clamped to the platform maximum

put.description: Rename, pause/reactivate, change the expiry or the daily cap.

post.description: Generate a new public token. The previous link stops working immediately — use this if a link leaked or was shared too widely.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of documents belonging to your organization.

post.description: Upload a PDF document. Maximum file size is 20 MB.

title.description: Document title (defaults to filename if omitted)

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific document.

delete.description: Delete a document. Only documents in `draft` status can be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of signature requests.

post.description: Create a new signature request with one or more signers. The request is created in `draft` status and must be sent explicitly via the send endpoint.

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. Use a new key, or replay the original body unchanged.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Send a unique key (for example your own order reference) to make this call safely repeatable. If the network drops after your request reaches us but before you get the response, replay the exact same call with the same key: you receive the original response — same body, same status, with an `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header — and no second signature request is created, so no second SMS is billed. Reusing a key with a DIFFERENT body returns 409: that is an integration bug, not a retry. Keys are scoped to your organization and honoured for 24 hours. Failed responses never consume a key.

get.description: Retrieve full details of a signature request, including signers, signature zones, and download links.

post.description: Send the signature request to all signers. This changes the status from `draft` to `pending` and sends invitation emails.
Cancel a pending signature request. Only requests in `pending` status can be cancelled.

get.description: Download the signed PDF document. Only available after all signers have completed signing.
Download the audit proof PDF, containing a detailed log of all signing actions with timestamps and IP addresses.
List all webhook endpoints for your organization.

post.description: Register a new webhook endpoint. The response includes the signing secret which is only shown once.

url.description: The HTTPS URL to receive webhook payloads

put.description: Update a webhook endpoint's URL, events, or active status.

delete.description: Delete a webhook endpoint and all its delivery logs.

get.description: View delivery logs for a specific webhook endpoint.

post.description: Generate a new signing secret for the webhook endpoint. The old secret will no longer be valid.

bearerAuth.description: Obtain a token via POST /auth/token, then pass it as: Authorization: Bearer {token}

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the original file

extended_retention.description: True if your organization's commercial contract includes the extended archiving option (10 years). Informational only — reflects the billed option, not a distinct technical purge policy.

redirect_url.description: URL shown to the signer as an explicit "return to <domain>" button on the success page. Must use https and match the domain declared for your organization (contact support to register it).

payment.description: Present only when a payment was requested on this sign request (see the `payment` field on creation). The signer is invited to pay only after signing ("sign then pay") — `checkout_url` is null until the sign request is fully signed.

checkout_url.description: Stripe Checkout link, only present while status is processing (i.e. the sign request has been fully signed and the signer has not yet paid).

document_id.description: UUID of a previously uploaded document

message.description: Optional message included in the invitation email

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for your records

redirect_url.description: Must use https and match the domain declared for your organization, or the request is rejected with a 422. Contact support to register your domain.

payment.description: Request a payment from the signer once they've signed ("sign then pay" — the signature is never blocked by payment). Requires an active Stripe Connect account for your organization (see Settings > Paiement à la signature), or the request is rejected with a 422. JuriSign never holds the funds: they go directly to your own Stripe account, minus a fixed 0.90€ platform fee.

amount_cents.description: Amount to collect from the signer, in cents.

signing_order_type.description: 0 = parallel (all signers at once), 1 = sequential (one after another)

expiry_hours.description: Hours until the request expires (max 30 days)

zones.description: Signature zone positions. Auto-generated at bottom of last page if omitted.

type.description: Field type. 'date' is always auto-filled at signing time, never editable by the signer.

label.description: Instruction shown to the signer. Required when type is 'text' or 'checkbox'.

required.description: For 'text'/'checkbox' zones only: blocks signing until filled. Ignored for 'signature'/'date'.

require_selfie.description: Require signers to take a selfie for identity verification

label.description: Instruction shown to the signer for text/checkbox fields

required.description: Whether a text/checkbox field must be filled before the signer can sign

value.description: Value entered by the signer (text/checkbox) or auto-filled date. Populated only once the sign request is signed.

secret.description: Full secret only shown on creation
